Kernel image: tftp/arm64/zos/Image
Exact configuration: tftp/arm64/zos/Image.config
Initramfs: tftp/arm64/zos/init.cpio.gz (FOG FOS/Buildroot with ZOS agent)

Purpose:
- Generic UEFI/ACPI ARM64 maintenance boot
- Proxmox/QEMU virt
- VirtIO PCI/MMIO network, block, SCSI and GPU
- PL011 and 8250 serial consoles
- EFI framebuffer/simpledrm/noVNC console
- gzip, XZ and Zstandard initramfs decoding

The x86_64 and LoongArch64 maintenance assets were not replaced by this ARM64 kernel build.

Build note: all required maintenance drivers are built into the kernel; CONFIG_MODULES is disabled.
